The provided documents detail two distinct but related aspects of the Strata software ecosystem: a highly technical optimization campaign for Intel Arc GPUs and comprehensive user-facing documentation for the Strata inference platform.

**A770 Speed Optimization Specification**
The first document, `A770_SPEED_SPEC.md`, outlines a rigorous engineering effort to achieve at least 20 tokens per second (tok/s) in decode throughput on an Intel Arc A770 GPU running the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Coder model. The baseline performance was established between 9 and 13 tok/s, with the primary bottleneck identified not as raw GPU compute power, but as latency in the host-to-GPU handoff for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers.

The specification defines strict completion criteria, requiring reproducible benchmarks, correctness gates (such as specific arithmetic answers), and preservation of context capacity. It details several "Work Packages" (WP) aimed at optimization:
*   **WP1 & WP2:** Focused on reliable event-based measurements and comparing BF16 projection paths. Results showed that the default path was superior to row-based kernels, and register tuning (GRF sizes) yielded no improvements or regressions.
